<span id="4f919988"></span>
# Applicable scenario


|Metric type |Description |Applicable scenario |How to count business metrics in the AB platform? |
|---|---|---|---|
|Event metrics |Metrics calculated based on user behavior events. |PV, UV, click through rate and other user behavior metrics. |The customer processes the business data in the data warehouse table into the format of behavioral events and reports it to the AB platform. |
|Number of positions metric |Index calculation based on data warehouse table calculation. |Business data such as GMV and AUM are generally not reported with behavioral events. |ABS platform integration data warehouse table, the platform side uses the user's existing storage and computing resources for index query, and displays the results on the platform. |


<span id="8d2a420e"></span>
# Usage restrictions and precautions


* Version requirements: V 4.6.0 above version supports the number of warehouses metric functions.

* Supported data sources: The current data source types supported by the warehouse metric include: Hive, Clickhouse, ByteHouse CE, ByteHouse CDW.

   <div data-tips="true" data-tips-type="tip" data-tips-is-title="true" data-wrapper-indent="1">tip   </div>
   

   <div data-tips="true" data-tips-type="tip" data-wrapper-indent="1">4.9.0 version supports data sources of ClickHouse, ByteHouse CE, and ByteHouse CDW types.   </div>
   

* Prerequisites: Before using the data warehouse metric, you need to contact the technical support staff and apply for permission to enable this function in "Version Management".


<span id="数仓指标使用方法"></span>
# How to use the data warehouse metric

<span id="操作步骤"></span>
## Usage flow


1. In the data warehouse, prepare the **metric table** that needs to be calculated in the A/B experimental platform, and need to include user_id and date fields.

2. Configure data links in the A/B experimental platform "Open Capability \- Data Warehouse Integration \- Data Source".

3. Configure temporary **intermediate table** (view) and **incoming table in A/B experimental platform "Open Capability\-Data Warehouse Integration\-Dataset".** 

4. In the A/B experimental platform "Metric Management \- Metric Group List \- Data Warehouse Metric Group", configure the **Digital Warehouse Metric.** 

5. Select the created warehouse metric when creating an experiment.

6. View warehouse metrics in lab reports.


<span id="d057e4bc"></span>
## Data docking program overview

A/B experimental platform in the calculation of data warehouse metrics, by entering the table and the business data table stored in the customer's data warehouse at the same time, associated query index calculation, using the customer's original own storage and computing resources for experimental index calculation, to achieve customer cost minimization to complete the calculation of business metrics in the experiment.

<span id="目前已支持的计算方式"></span>
# Reference: Currently supported calculation methods

At present, the 8 calculation methods shown in the table below are supported. If you need to add new ones, please contact the technical support staff.


|Calculation method |Whether to support confidence level calculation |
|---|---|
|Summation |This calculation method can count results, but cannot calculate confidence levels |
|Number of times |This calculation method can count results, but cannot calculate confidence levels |
|Ask for the number of people |This calculation method can count results, but cannot calculate confidence levels |
|Find the average |\-\- |
|Average |\-\- |
|Number of times per capita |\-\- |
|Find the average of the group |\-\- |
|Ask for percentiles |This calculation method can count results, but cannot calculate confidence levels |


<span id="常见问题"></span>
# Reference: Frequently Asked Question

Q: How to obtain the incoming data?

The acquisition of group data varies according to the usage mode of each customer. You can choose to report the group event by yourself, consume the group kafka of datatester, etc. If you need assistance with specific plans, you can contact us.
